name: Workspace note
description: Create a small workspace note and check that it was written. A runnable example for connecting your own application.
command:
printf 'Workspace note

Generated by the local example application.
' > WORKSPACE_NOTE.txt; cat WORKSPACE_NOTE.txt
acceptance:
test -s "$MITOS_WORKSPACE/WORKSPACE_NOTE.txt" && printf 'Acceptance passed: workspace note exists and is non-empty.
'
